english.title: Accept unauthorised payment in respect of long-term holiday product contract
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a trader, accepted a payment in respect of a regulated long-term holiday product contract when that payment had not been made in accordance with a schedule which complied with the requirements of regulation 26 of the Timeshare, Holiday Products, Resale and Exchange Contracts Regulations 2010
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 26(1) and (5) and 27 of the Timeshare, Holiday Products, Resale and Exchange Contracts Regulations 2010.

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding the statutory maximum
Indictment: A fine

Time Limit on Prosecutions;
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
